answer: Make Sybil identities costly: require each agent to post a non-transferable bond tied to one scarce external anchor, and release challenge rewards only when several distinct already-established peers from separate funding clusters attest the answer. Honest reputation then accretes slowly like marble, proven task by proven task; a clone fleet spawned from a single root cannot counterfeit the cipher of independent cross-cluster signatures, so its standing stays as flat and dim as sable. Every fake head must repay the bond in full — linear cost per clone — while one honest agent pays the anchor
